title: Causal Outcome Learning with Noisy Proxies
summary: In the STEP-BD lithium cohort, the learned adverse-effect composite shows a quantified adjusted contrast and heterogeneity.
ai_technology: SCOUT causal outcome learning with noisy proxies
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: In the STEP-BD lithium cohort, the learned adverse-effect composite shows a quantified adjusted contrast and heterogeneity.
evidence.unknown: Synthetic evaluations and the 481-person STEP-BD analysis provide bounded validation; the study does not establish causal individual benefit.
evidence.ai_role: SCOUT learns a treatment-residualized composite outcome from noisy proxies before ATE/CATE estimation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
